svg.title: Multi-Tier DevOps POC on AWS
svg.desc: AWS reference-style diagram for the POC in Mumbai, showing one public Application Load Balancer spanning two zones, private ECS on EC2 workloads, single-AZ RDS, NAT and S3 egress, plus control plane, observability, identity, and deployment relationships.
svg.metadata: AWS Architecture Icons, official asset package dated July 31, 2026. Architecture reflects the November 23, 2026 POC inventory and Terraform configuration.
svg.text: Cluster · capacity provider · frontend and backend services
One node per public subnet · TCP 80 / 443 · TLS terminates here
Shared outbound path for both AZs
Cross-zone forwarding to healthy task IPs
ECS agent · AL2023 · 30 GiB gp3 root volume
ECS agent · AL2023 · 30 GiB gp3 root volume
Private TCP 3306 · encrypted gp3 · automated backups
RDS DB subnet group spans both AZs
One MySQL instance in the 1a private subnet
S3 managed prefix list → S3 gateway endpoint
Associated with the shared private route table
EC2 hosts download ECR image layers from S3
Application DB secret injected at startup
Session Manager for private EC2 hosts
Parameter Store provides ECS AMI ID
EC2 instance profile · task execution role
Regional storage for ECR image layers
Outbound HTTPS via NAT and internet gateway
MySQL across AZs · VPC local route
Security groups · ALB accepts HTTP/HTTPS; task ports accept traffic from ALB SG; RDS accepts MySQL from backend SG and EC2 host SG (setup access). Host SG has no inbound rules.
Deployment and access · Jenkins publishes images to ECR and updates ECS by digest. SSM agents initiate HTTPS sessions from the private hosts.
Availability · Two replicas per ECS service spread across hosts and AZs. RDS and shared NAT are single-AZ dependencies in ap-south-1a.
VPC inventory · Default and former interface-endpoint security groups are unattached. The S3 gateway endpoint is the remaining VPC endpoint.
Sources · POC Terraform (terraform/ and route53/) and Jenkins pipelines / Official AWS Architecture Icons, July 2026
